India backs UN resolution to correct world maps

India has supported a United Nations resolution aimed at correcting world maps, a move that has garnered support from 164 countries. The resolution, referred to as 'Correct the Map', addresses historical inaccuracies and aims to update geographical representations. While the exact details of the historical map changes and the specific reasons for the support from African nations and the displeasure from the US are not elaborated in the provided coverage, the initiative has united a significant majority of UN member states. The resolution's passage in the UN signifies a collective effort to rectify long-standing geographical discrepancies.
